name: 到期管家
description: Track due dates and Apple Reminders with system-language widgets, left-aligned compact details, and readable middle-truncated metadata.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.3.6 restores left alignment for the small widget’s amount and note, while retaining native tightening and middle truncation for long medium/large metadata.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.3.6 将小号金额与备注恢复为左对齐，并保持中、大号过长备注的原生字距收紧与中间省略优化。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.3.6 将小号金额与备注恢复为左对齐，并保持中、大号过长备注的原生字距收紧与中间省略优化。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.3.6 將小號金額與備註恢復為左對齊，並保持中、大號過長備註的原生字距收緊與中間省略優化。
